A city

flowers.

We're a make-believe bee club with a real soft spot for the little things.

Honeycomb Hotel imagines a city where rooftops, windowsills, and forgotten corners become places for pollinators to stop by. Because a patch of flowers can make the everyday feel a little more alive.
